paragraphs.source_en: This is why I did not want to involve Mustang. Inviting her into the game is adding another dimension I can’t control. She knows what I’m thinking. I can’t let her leave this hangar.

paragraphs.source_en: “You can’t. That is why I am coming with you. To prove I believe in your wife’s dream. But you have to prove something to me. That you are worthy of my trust, in turn. I know you can break. I need to see that you can build. I need to see what you will build. If the blood we will shed is for something. Prove that, and you have my sword. Fail, and you and I will go our separate ways.” She cocks her head at me. “So what do you say, Helldiver? Do you want to give it one more go?”
